data.name: Balghis
data.gender_notes: Balghis is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is delightful and beautiful to look at. The name Balghis carries the meaning “Delightful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Balghis usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Balghis belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delightful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balghis total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: بلقيس
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من بلقسة، ذات جمال وبهاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بلقيس مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ب-ل-ق-س، ويعني المرأة ذات الجمال والبهاء، وورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة النمل، حيث كانت بلقيس ملكة سبأ، مشهورة بذكائها وحكمتها، وتعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية عميقة وتاريخية غنية في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: بلقیس
in_urdu.meaning: خوبصورتی اور جمال کی مالک، شاہی خاندان کی علامت
in_urdu.long_meaning: بلقیس نام عربی زبان کے جذر ب-ل-ق-س سے ماخوذ ہے، جو خوبصورتی اور جمال کی علامت ہے، یہ نام تاریخی طور پر ملکہ سبا کی بادشاہہ کے نام سے وابستہ ہے، جو اپنی حکمت اور ذہانت کے لئے مشہور تھیں، اور اسلامی روایات میں اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں سورہ نمل میں کیا گیا ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے روحانی اور ثقافتی اہمیت کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: बल्क़ीस
in_hindi.meaning: सुंदरता और शोभा की स्वामिनी, ऐश्वर्य की प्रतीक
in_hindi.long_meaning: बल्क़ीस नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के मूल ब-ल-ق-س से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता और शोभा, यह नाम ऐश्वर्य और सुंदरता की प्रतीक है, और यह ऐतिहासिक रूप से सबा की रानी के नाम से जुड़ा हुआ है, जो अपनी बुद्धिमत्ता और सुंदरता के लिए प्रसिद्ध थीं, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है

in_english.name: Balghis
in_english.meaning: Symbol of beauty and intelligence, queen of Sheba
in_english.long_meaning: The name Balghis originates from the Arabic root b-l-q-s, signifying beauty and intelligence, historically associated with the Queen of Sheba, mentioned in the Quran, Surah An-Naml, known for her wisdom and beauty, this name holds spiritual and cultural significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing feminine elegance and strength, widely used across Muslim cultures

In many Arab societies, names are given based on their meanings and the traits they represent, and "Balghis" is no exception. A person with this name is likely to be admired and held in high esteem for their physical appearances and charisma. It also adds to the individual's social status and can influence how they are perceived in their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Balghis" carries a deeper meaning beyond physical beauty. It reminds us of the inherent worth and dignity of every human being. We are all created in the image of Allah, and no matter our appearances, we are precious to Him. The name encourages us to see beauty in the inner qualities of others, such as kindness, generosity, and compassion. It also serves as a reminder for us to strive for inner beauty, as it is what truly matters in the eyes of Allah. Ultimately, "Balghis" is a name that invites us to appreciate and value all forms of beauty, both inside and out.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Balghis is a name of noble character and strong will. It symbolizes one who is steadfast, resilient, and unwavering in their beliefs and actions. Balghis represents the strength and determination to overcome challenges and obstacles, while remaining true to one's faith and values.
